Thirteen exact matches, one commit each, and the progress report in its own last commit. |---|---|---|

merged.untrustedBody:
Forty level units matched in parallel, one worker each, bounded at 18 functions or 150 minutes. The catalogue frontier entries are filtered out of the targets this time, which is what the last two waves asked for: 271 of 3,514 candidates had no `jr $ra` in their span and were dropped before anyone was assigned one.
